notes.title: Crafting, New Cards & More: The 'Scrap & Stitch' Update is Here!
notes.notes:

Now, we're taking the next giant leap forward. [/p][list][*][p] [b]Finishers:[/b] Unlock and equip brand-new ways to cast your finishing move. Give your victories that extra flair.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Emotes:[/b] A whole new set of emotes to express... well, whatever you want to express to your opponent during battle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178110/9c4193ec40229b0fcec0c0d1529051b31636021d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Celebrate with Special Bundles[/h2][p]To celebrate our biggest update yet, we've added special discounted bundles to the store. notes.title: The "Command+Z" Update is here!
notes.notes:
Sometimes you just need an undo button. And sometimes, you just want the game to go faster. This update is all about giving you more control and more speed, based directly on your feedback.

[h2]Undo This.[/h2]
Ever played a software card and immediately wished you could take it back? Now you can. You can cancel any software while it's targeting. For ultimate control, head to the settings and disable autoconfirm to get a cancel option on every card you play. Your misclicks are officially a thing of the past.

[h2]Don't Waste A Second.[/h2]
We're speeding things up. The stack will now automatically resolve if your opponent has no response, getting you to the action faster. We love speed, but we also love options, so you can turn this off in the settings if you prefer the manual approach.

[h2]Hoot Went To College.[/h2]
Our training AI, Hoot, has been hitting the books. He's now significantly smarter and can handle more complex strategies, providing a much better challenge for when you're testing out new decks and ideas.

[h2]The Great Rebalance.[/h2]
We’ve been listening closely to your discussions about the meta. This update brings a massive wave of balancing changes to skills and cards to ensure gameplay stays fair, diverse, and free of abuse.

[h2]No Glitch Left Behind.[/h2]
There’s nothing worse than finding the perfect match, only for a connection drop on the VS screen to send you back to an endless queue. We’ve fixed that. The matchmaker will now auto-reconnect, getting you into the game without the frustrating wait.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the option to cancel glitches/software during targeting.
[*]Added an autoresolve option for faster gameplay.
[*]Added support for Traditional Chinese.
[*]Added a separate "Deals" section in the store.
[*]Added auto-restarting search in matchmaking when an opponent disconnects during the VS screen.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the opponent's avatar wouldn't load in the battleground.
[*]Significantly improved the loading time of battlegrounds.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chaos Oracle: 1/4 -> 3/4
[*]Circle of Life: "Destroy all allies. You heal 2 for each sacrificed Glitch." -> "Destroy all allies. You heal 3 for each sacrificed Glitch."
[*]Duelist Rascal: 2/2 -> 1/5
[*]Fashion killer: 4/5 -> 3/5, Cost 4 -> 3, Ability Cost 1 -> 3, Added Protector
[*]Hypeman: 2/1 -> 1/1
[*]Memory Extraction: "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Deal 2 damage to you opponent for each talent that Glitch had." -> "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Deal 1 damage to you opponent for each talent that Glitch had."
[*]Reckless Renegade: 1/4 -> 2/5; Cost 3 -> 2; "Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to the defending Glitch or Player and 4 damage to this at the end of combat." -> "Whenever this attacks, deal 2 damage to it. (before the attack)"
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Erazer: Cost 6 -> 4; "Remove all talents from a Glitch." -> "Disable all talents of a Glitch until end of turn."
[*]Ethereal Leap: Cost 4 -> 5
[*]Ghost Rage: "Give an ally {Aggressor} and +1 power for every ally that has died this turn." -> "Give an ally +1 power for every ally that has died this turn."
[*]Masochism: Cost 10 -> 5; "Deal 1 damage to all Glitches on the battlefield and give a Glitch +1 power for all affected Glitches." -> "Deal 1 damage to all allies and give a Glitch +1 power for all affected Glitches."
[*]Memory Lapse: Cost 5 -> 4
[*]Sticks and Stones: Cost 5 -> 3; "Deal 2 damage to your opponent." -> "Deal 1 damage to your opponent."
[*]TimeGeist: Cost 6 -> 8; "The next card that you draw costs 0 energy." -> "The next card that you draw costs 1 energy."
[*]Unleash: Cost 4 -> 5
[*]Void Strike: Cost 9 -> 7
[*]WorldEnder: Cost 6 -> 10; Talents are added to shroomy before creation not triggering for example the Socialite.
[*]Zennith Vitality: Cost 6 -> 5
[/list]

[b]Text changes only[/b]
[list]
[*]Truth Seeker: "Whenever you look at any number of cards in your deck, give this +2 power."
[*]Colour Augmentor: "Whenever another ally receives damage, give that Glitch+1 power."
[/list]

notes.title: Balancing patch (changelog 0.9.9.91)
notes.notes:
Our first big balancing patch after the steam release focuses mainly on buffing cards that had less success or popularity than we'd like to and nerfing some skills that are performing a little too well.

[b]Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bodyshield: "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Stop Software with a cost of 3 or lower." -> "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Stop Software with Installation required."
[*] Chaos Oracle: 2/2 -> 1/4
[*] Defensive Assault: +2 power -> +3 power
[*] Elixir of Aggression: Cost: 1 -> 2, Plug & Play -> Installation required, "Remove {Protector} from all allies until end of turn." -> "Remove {Protector} from all allies."
[*] Encrypt: Cost 2 -> 1
[*] Erazer: Cost: 3 -> 2, Plug & Play -> Installation Required
[*] Fleetfoot Gambit: Cost: 3 -> 2
[*] Magus' Apprentice: 2/2 -> 1/4
[*] The Pirate Queen: 1/4 -> 2/4, Cost: 3 -> 4, added Troll
[*] Pointless Purge: Cost 1 -> 0
[*] Robot Thing: Cost: 3 -> 1
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pacify: Cost 4 -> 6
[*] BackTrack: Cost: 4 -> 5
[*] BackTrack Blast: "Deinitialise a Glitch that costs 2 or less." -> "Deinitialise an ally."
[*] BitTrip: Cost: 8 -> 10
[*] Gut Punch: Cost 4 -> 5
[/list]

We also adjusted the usage of the word "ally" to be more clear. Now "Ally" includes the card itself, if it doesn't we use "another ally". These are the affected cards. This is a text only change, all their effects stay the same:
[list]
[*] Capy Engineer 
[*] Colour Augmentor 
[*] Data Sucker 
[*] Friend Bot 
[*] Socialite
[*] Speedy Scrapper
[/list]



[b]We also did some bugfixes & improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Oracle Trick to last until end of turn
[*] Fixed Grave Replicant not working as intended when transformed
[*] Fixed cost reduction calculations
[*] Fixed case where Software would count as played even if fizzled
[*] Fixed Fashion Killer description
[*] added fixed dates for challenges: Dailies reset every day at 17:00 UTC+2, Weeklies every Monday at 17:00 UTC+2, Monthlies on the 17th of every month at 17:00 UTC+2
[/list]

notes.title: selection of playmodes and improved matchmaking (changelog 0.9.8.9.9)
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing The Lost Glitches! We've been following the conversations and are excited to announce selection of different playmodes: ranked/unranked/training.
You can now select to play "unranked" against other opponents who want to test their decks. Unranked matches won't impact your season rank. Or you can play in "training" mode against an AI, to quickly jump in a match against our very own Hoot!

Here's the full changelog, have fun playing <3

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] added overview of season rewards in the season page
[*] added more feedback when searching for quickmatch
[*] added spanish support
[*] added variable text size for cards (also editable in the settings menu)
[*] added ranked/unranked/training mode. Go in the unranked queue to play against a random opponent without the match influencing your season rank or play in training mode against the AI.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] improved matchmaking to search within a player's rating regularly, even when doing an extended search
[*] time abusers go now to a separate queue for a timeout 
[*] negated software go to the graveyard (not exile)
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed Socialite & Echoing Harpy having wrong text
[*] fixed Income Tax and improved wording
[*] fixed Master Hacker not correctly finding the strongest enemy
[*] fixed Sacriscythe could not be used when only one glitch was on the board
[*] fixed case of activated abilities not consistently triggering multiple times
[*] fixed case where a disconnect from a player wouldn't register sometimes and the game would hang
[/list]

notes.title: changelog 0.9.9.8.81
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the ongoing support and feedback. We noticed that matchmaking was reaching server rate limits, so we patched it. Now the quickmatch screen shouldn't timeout in the "loading battleground" message. 
We also managed to sneak some smaller, quality of life fixes. 

The complete changelog:

[list]
[*] fixed case where matchmaking requests would reach rate limits of the server leading to a "loading battleground" timeout
[*] fixed current locale not taken into account in the dropdown 
[*] fixed case where the spanish locale was used although not available
[*] fixed case where in certain screen aspect ratios the tier#3 skills weren't draggable
[*] fixed System Crasher not being visible
[*] fixed case where a popup would appear if you right click on an empty skill slot on the battleground
[*] fixed Shrappie Shrapnel, Speedy Scrapper combo having a limit 
[/list]

Thank you for playing, see you in the battlegrounds!

notes.title: changelog 0.9.9.8.8
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

we've been participating in discussions, discord chats and reviews and have made some improvements based on your requests and feedback.

[b]Features & improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] added steam login. Custom authentication is no longer required. 
[*] added right click to cards/skills in the stack to see more info about them
[*] added portuguese and russian localizations.
[*] adjusted turn timer to avoid abuse. Previously for every phase the timer would reset to 90 seconds. This made turn duration very long especially if someone abused it. Adjusted with a global turn timer and extra time for attacking/defending.
[*] added a hotzone on the battlefield for initialising a glitch/software. Dropping a card outside of this hotzone, returns it to hand.
[*] added text to onboarding to explain how to cancel initialising a glitch/software
[*] added your challenges progress in values (e.g. 12/30) as well as end time.
[*] tightened matchmaking to reduce cases where players with different rating would be matched together. (Season rank shown in quickmatch is different than the user's global rating.)
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes: [/b]    
[list]
[*] take system language when starting the tutorial for correct localization
[*] fixed steam achievements: win against higher rank, init 10 shroomies
[*] fixed cases where the Skill Points would go below 0.
[*] fixed rendering of exclusive cards
[*] make sure cards don't remain on the stack
[*] fixed keywords hovering not working in some cases
[*] disallow first turn combat during third tutorial battle
[*] Fixed "Cycle" not working as intended
[*] Fixed ability of "Cappy Engineer" not triggering
[*] Fixed "Mountain Walker" not working as intended
[*] Fixed Hoot outdated talents shown on mulligan
[*] Fixed Taxman typo
[*] better wording for "submitting tickets"
[/list]

[b]Balancing: [/b]
[u]Cards:[/u]
[list]
[*] + Eternity Sage: 4/4 -> 4/5, removed Encrypted, added Overflow
[*] + Sky Guardian: 2/1 -> 1/2, Cost 3 -> 2
[/list]
[u]Skills:[/u]
[list]
[*] BackTrack: Cost 3 -> 4
[*] BitTrip: Cost 6 -> 8
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.9.8.7
notes.notes:
Thank you Glitches for jumping on our steam release and playing the game! 
We've been following all discussions and comments and are grateful for the feedback you're sharing. While we are preparing a bigger patch with some content updates, we would like to share a quality of life patch that improves your game experience.

changelog 0.9.9.8.7
